Catching up with old friends during our Hanoi holiday
Sep 2026 • Friends
We came up from Saigon to Hanoi for the 2 September holiday, so the city was already buzzing when we arrived. A local friend took our group to Mala for hotpot, and it turned out to be a good place for a catch-up meal. The restaurant was clean and cool inside, and thankfully there wasn't much of that heavy cooking-oil smell. The portions looked generous, and the buffet worked out quite reasonably when split among a larger group. The staff were quick and helpful whenever we asked for extra ice or dipping sauce. If we come back to Hanoi, I’d definitely consider stopping by again.

A hotpot meal that fits Hanoi’s early autumn weather
Sep 2026 • Solo
I come here fairly often whenever I crave Thai-style hotpot, so it has become a familiar place for me. Hanoi has been getting cooler these days, and sitting down with a steaming pot of hotpot feels just right for the season. The dipping sauce station has plenty of seasonings, so you can mix your own sauce depending on your taste. There is also a good variety of ingredients, and the shrimp and squid I had were fresh and not mushy. The dessert station was running low on a few items because of the crowd, so I had to ask the staff to refill them. Other than that, it was a comfortable meal.

A relaxed hotpot dinner for the weekend
Aug 2026 • Friends
My partner and I came here for a casual weekend dinner and wanted something warm and filling. The restaurant was very busy that evening, but the staff still kept an eye on the tables and refilled our broth without us having to ask repeatedly. The broth had a nice sour and spicy flavor, and the beef looked fresh and tasted good. Prices were clearly listed, so the bill was straightforward and there were no unexpected charges. One small issue was that the air conditioning felt a little too cold, so I'd recommend bringing a light jacket if you're sensitive to cold rooms.

A convenient dinner after a few days of work in Hanoi
Aug 2026 • Business
I was in Hanoi for a few days on a business trip during the busy National Day period, and a colleague recommended Mala for dinner. What stood out most to me was how professionally the staff handled a small issue. One seafood dish was missing from our order, so we mentioned it to the staff and the manager, Quoc Viet, came over to apologize and arrange a replacement fairly quickly. The situation was handled politely and without any unnecessary back-and-forth, which made a good impression. The food itself was enjoyable, with a light, naturally sweet broth and well-seasoned ingredients.

Quick and easy solo lunch
Aug 2026 • Solo
Too lazy to cook for lunch on a sunny day, so I popped in here and ordered the shrimp paste fried rice to eat quickly before returning to rest. Big plus for the super fast service; it took about 5 minutes for the hot plate of rice to arrive. The rice grains were loose and fluffy, carrying a distinct shrimp paste aroma, paired with shredded mango and cucumber to cut the grease. Clean and cool space with cheerful Thai music playing. Affordable price, good for lazy days like this.

Dropping by alone to satisfy my Thai craving
Jul 2026 • Solo
Heard about this place for a while, today I had errands in Binh Thanh so I dropped by alone.
